c1-yellow-river.label: Crisis 1 — The Blood River
c1-yellow-river.summary: The Yellow River runs red across 300km simultaneously. Twelve million lose drinking water.

c2-yangtze.label: Crisis 2 — The Second River
c2-yangtze.summary: The Yangtze turns red overnight. Thirty per cent of national freshwater compromised.

c3-crops.label: Crisis 3 — The Crops
c3-crops.summary: Root rot across Hebei, Shandong and Henan. The decay moves in patterns.

c4-locusts.label: Crisis 4 — The Locusts
c4-locusts.summary: A 2,000 sq km swarm follows the Yangtze in formation. The second seal has been opened.

c5-prophecy.label: Crisis 5 — The Prophecy
c5-prophecy.summary: An unsigned four-sentence document appears in seven cities at once and claims responsibility.

c6-darkness.label: Crisis 6 — The Darkness
c6-darkness.summary: Daylight fails over three northern cities. The fourth seal, delivered on schedule.

c7-sickness.label: Crisis 7 — The Sickness
c7-sickness.summary: Respiratory illness overwhelms the basins. Taiwan offers a medical mission.

c8-strait.label: Crisis 8 — The Strait
c8-strait.summary: The phenomena appear in Taiwan. White Lotus does not claim it.
